name: IT team · vigilance — PM shifts are dying with `name 'tags' is not defined` (2 losses in 24 h)
description:
Context: two ProjectManager shifts ended in `status: error` before they could write a shift report. Evidence is in the task descriptions themselves (no runtime logs are exposed to `search_codx(modules=["logs"])`, which scans 0 files):

- `f2ed6ed3` — Shift 2026-11-20 08:17 — "**Shift failed:** name 'tags' is not defined"
- `86b16566` — Shift 2026-11-19 16:36 — "**Shift failed:** name 'tags' is not defined"

Both sit in `Agent: ProjectManager/Done` with `status: error`. The 08:17 shift is the immediate predecessor of this card's author, which is why the board had no hand-off and had to be re-audited from scratch.

Why it matters to delivery: a shift that dies before reporting is invisible drift. It is the same class of defect as a silent `allow` from the QA gate (`f3e1dd0c`) — the failure produces no signal. Two losses in 24 h is a pattern, not a one-off.

Why this is a vigilance card and not a fix card: the defect lives in the shift runner of the platform, not in `codx-junior-installer` (0 python, all shell + markdown). Whether platform code is in scope at all is the open question on `e70e0272` (12:00Z today, default: parent repo OUT of scope). Opening a fix card in a repo that cannot hold the fix would be an unexecutable card.

Do on wake:
1. List the `Agent: ProjectManager` shift cards and count how many are in `status: error` since 2026-11-19.
2. If **no new failure** occurred → close this card with one line of evidence (the count).
3. If a **third** failure occurred → do not open a code card here. Escalate: write the finding on `e70e0272`'s sibling decision path as a platform issue, name the failing shift ids, and report it in the shift report as a delivery risk (lost PM capacity, not a code defect).

Acceptance criterion: a comment stating the error-shift count since 2026-11-19 with the ids, and either a close or a named escalation. One shift of work at most.

## ESCALATION — this is no longer a PM-only pattern: **every agent seat is dying, and it now threatens the 21 Nov demo**

Checked one shift early because the same error is on today's 12:00Z wakes. **The count is not 2 — it is 10 error shifts since 2026-11-19, across four different agents.**

| Shift | Agent | Started (UTC) |
|---|---|---|
| `ba486935` | software_developer | 11-19 16:33 |
| `75722ccc` | qa | 11-19 16:35 |
| `86b16566` | ProjectManager | 11-19 16:36 |
| `459deb89` | software_developer | 11-20 08:14 |
| `9a52fe50` | qa | 11-20 08:15 |
| `f2ed6ed3` | ProjectManager | 11-20 08:17 |
| `c91bacc3` | ciso | 11-20 08:18 |
| `9b748513` | ProjectManager | 11-20 09:28 |
| `1acfed39` | software_developer | 11-20 12:38 |
| `3b412b17` | qa | 11-20 12:41 |

All in `status: error`, description overwritten with `**Shift failed:** name 'tags' is not defined`.

### Why this is now the top delivery risk (not a housekeeping item)
The M1 demo on 21 Nov does not run on a human — it runs on **five scheduled agent shifts**: `101588b6` 09:00Z rehearsal, `4f055e99` 10:30Z no-go branch, `def4ce38` 11:00Z evidence pack, `6bceef9e` 12:15Z pre-flight, `140c8fb0` 17:00Z QA verdict. Today's sample is 2 failures out of 4 agent shifts started between 08:14 and 12:41. **If that rate holds, the recording and the pre-flight both die and Option C produces nothing** — the M1 fallback stops being "acceptance by recording" and becomes "no evidence at all".

### Ruling (per your own step 3 — escalate, do not open a code card here)
- **No code card is opened in this project.** The defect is in the shift runner of `codx-junior-platform`, which the scope decision on `e70e0272` (2026-11-20 12:00Z, **Option A**) placed **out of scope** for these shifts. A fix card here would be unexecutable.
- **Escalated as a platform issue** in this comment, with the ids above. It needs a human on the platform side.
- **Reported as a delivery risk**, not a task: lost agent capacity. Named in the 2026-11-20 shift report.
- **Re-armed**: this card now wakes **2026-11-21T08:00Z** (was 23 Nov 09:30) — one hour before the M1 rehearsal, so the count is re-taken with the demo still recoverable. Status `onhold` until a human acts; do not re-scan, the ids above are the evidence.

### Acceptance (unchanged in spirit)
A comment stating the error-shift count with ids — done above (10) — plus a named escalation — done above. Closing action belongs to the human who fixes the runner.

## Vigilance re-check, shift #12 (2026-11-23 08:57Z) — **no new failure. Closing.**

Counted via `project_manager list_tasks board="Agent: ProjectManager"` (15 cards on the board):

| Shift card | Started (UTC) | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `86b16566` | 11-19 16:36 | error |
| `f2ed6ed3` | 11-20 08:17 | error |
| `9b748513` | 11-20 09:28 | error |
| `12ccf6f1` | 11-20 12:48 | error |
| **`ed96fa08`** | **11-23 08:57** | **doing — this shift, running normally** |

**Still 4 error shifts, all on or before 2026-11-20 12:48. Zero occurrences on 21, 22 and 23 Nov.** The `name 'tags' is not defined` crash has not recurred since the 20 Nov escalation, and this shift has executed 9 board operations without it. Per the card's own step 2 ("if no new failure occurred → close with one line of evidence"), this closes.

### The more important finding — the weekend was silent for a different reason
No agent shift ran at all on Sat 21 / Sun 22 Nov, and that is **not** the `tags` crash: the actor's availability is **Mon–Fri 09:00–19:00 Europe/Madrid**. Weekends are outside the window by design. That cost M1 its entire demo chain (5 gating cards armed on Saturday, all still `todo` — see `b9aaf03c` and `70832a68`).

So the delivery risk is **not** only "lost PM capacity to a runner bug" — it is "the PM scheduled its own proof outside its own working hours". That one is fixable here, without platform code, and it now carries a standing rule recorded on `2506f948`:

> No card that gates a deliverable may be armed outside Mon–Fri 09:00–19:00 Europe/Madrid.

### Disposition
- **No code card opened here** — the runner lives in `codx-junior-platform`, ruled out of scope by `e70e0272` (Option A). The 10-shift escalation from 20 Nov stands as written for the platform side; this card adds no new ids.
- **Closing as `done`.** Continuing to re-scan a bug that has not fired in 3 days is not vigilance, it is noise. If a fifth error shift appears, it reopens as a new card with the new evidence.
